supersedes: analysis/cohort1/config/tier_rules.json v1.0.0 (report definitions) and the production measurement-count corroboration rule (CLAUDE.md invariant 7, pre-cohort-1)
decisions: docs/COHORT-1-DECISIONS.md D06, D07, D08, D09, D10, D11, D12
status: Production trust rules. These decide which claims are drawn, ranked and counted.

source_scope.active_pharmacology_rule: ChEMBL 37 only, applied uniformly to retained seeds and new candidates. No supplementary seed evidence is carried forward into active tiers, ranking or support counts.

deferred.rule: Recorded as not assessed, never as a negative evidence finding and never as absence of pharmacology. D12 defers them to cohort 2.
deferred.historical: Their previously collected records stay in the legacy database and its backups with full provenance. They are not read by this build.

source_scope.no_live_fallback: The build fails if the pinned release is missing. It never falls back to a live ChEMBL release or a different snapshot.

enrichment.rule: Optional network enrichment (Wikipedia via Wikidata on an exact identifier) is separate from pharmacology evidence, resumable, and never able to erase a catalogue entry or block a pinned evidence build. Its failure is recorded as unresolved, not as absence.

claim_granularity.rule: Claims are stored and assessed at parent-target-role granularity. A well-evidenced claim never upgrades another claim for the same molecule. Binding never establishes an action; curated never upgrades a measured claim.
claim_granularity.endpoint_class_rule: endpoint_class = <role>:<standard_type>, role 'binding' for assay_type B and 'functional' for assay_type F. Replication is counted inside one endpoint class only.

target_identity.rule: D06: these four native ChEMBL target identities are retained as they are asserted. A family claim is a family claim and a complex claim is a complex claim; neither is expanded into component or subtype claims, and neither is merged with them.

component_relationships.rule: target_components / UniProt accessions are stored so a complex or family can name what it contains. They are never read as binding claims about the components and never used to distribute evidence over subunits or paralogues.

non_claimable_target_types.rule: Retained as observations with an explicit reason. They never become a named-protein edge. An unassigned or non-molecular observation is not converted into a protein claim under any filter, including the broader-assignment layer.
non_claimable_target_types.changed_from_analysis: The report's specificity() put confidence_score = 5 rows into its human family/multiple class regardless of target type, which silently admitted PROTEIN-PROTEIN INTERACTION (9,740 assays), SELECTIVITY GROUP (1,129) and conf-5 PROTEIN COMPLEX GROUP (2,827) into the broad human basis. D06 names four target levels; these are not among them.

grouping_for_display.rule: Visual grouping may draw a complex or family as one node, but it must not merge distinct source target records, and it must not increase any shared-target count. Overlap is matched at the actual target identity.
grouping_for_display.resolve_groups_note: The legacy export's resolve_groups reconciled overlapping complexes derived from component membership. It is not reused for claim identity: under this policy a PROTEIN COMPLEX and a PROTEIN COMPLEX GROUP that share components are two distinct target records with two distinct claims, and collapsing them would merge two source claims.

assignment_bases.primary_basis_rule: D07: the default view. Experimental eligibility requires target tax_id 9606, assays.relationship_type 'D', assays.variant_id NULL, and one of the target-type/confidence combinations below. A generic confidence >= 7 test is never used: 9, 7 and 8 are three different assignment categories, not a quality ranking.
assignment_bases.changed_from_analysis: The report's specificity() applied the relationship_type = 'D' and variant_id IS NULL requirements only to the single-protein branch. Its complex branch would have accepted the 109 human conf-7 PROTEIN COMPLEX assays that carry a variant, and its family branch the 11 variant-carrying PROTEIN FAMILY assays, as no-variant direct evidence. Production applies D and no-variant to all three classes, as the follow-up basis definition and the adopted policy state.
assignment_bases.broader_basis_label: Broader assignment (nonhuman, homologous, variant or ambiguous)
assignment_bases.broader_basis_rule: D07: an explicit optional layer, never mixed into the primary basis and never able to raise a primary-basis tier, score or shared-target count. Support is computed separately within each basis.

broader_classes.label: Human, variant or mutant target
broader_classes.rule: Primary target-type/confidence combination with variant_id NOT NULL. Preserved as a variant claim; never asserted as wild-type direct binding.

broader_classes.label: Nonhuman organism target
broader_classes.rule: Target tax_id present and not 9606. Distinct from an organism-format observation, which is excluded entirely below.

broader_classes.label: Ambiguous target assignment
broader_classes.rule: A claimable target type whose confidence_score does not match its class combination, or relationship_type not in (D, H).

never_eligible.label: Unassigned or non-molecular observation
never_eligible.rule: confidence_score <= 3, relationship_type in (N, S, M, U), or a non-claimable target type. Retained as an observation with its reason. Produces no claim and no edge in any basis or filter state.

assignment_bases.pooling_prohibition: Species, variants and assignment classes are never pooled to manufacture replication for a more specific claim. Two studies in different bases are not two studies for either.

curated_support.definition: A chembl_37 drug_mechanism record for this parent's compound family at this target, carrying at least one mechanism_refs row or a non-empty mechanism_comment.
curated_support.specificity: Qualifies only at the target and action level ChEMBL asserts. A PROTEIN FAMILY or PROTEIN COMPLEX mechanism is Supported at that level and is never expanded into supported claims for its members.
curated_support.caveat: One curator's assertion with a traceable reference. Not an independently replicated measurement, and it never upgrades a binding or functional claim.
curated_support.direct_interaction_note: drug_mechanism.direct_interaction = 0 is a known indirect assertion: recorded as limited_or_unresolved with reason curated_indirect, never converted into a direct binding claim.

multiple_study_support.definition: Two or more distinct study keys of provenance_class 'publication' carrying qualifying exact measurements for the same claim within one endpoint class, after assignment, species and variant filtering for the basis being assessed.
multiple_study_support.caveat: Multiple publications are a documented proxy for independence, not proof of independent laboratories, experiments or material.

supported.recorded_separately: curated_support and multiple_study_support are separate flags. The viewer distinguishes them; neither implies the other.

preliminary.definition: At least one identifiable eligible study (publication, patent or deposited dataset) with a qualifying exact measurement for the claim, and no Supported evidence for that claim in this basis.

limited_or_unresolved.definition: Retained observations that exist but do not meet the rules above. The reason is always preserved; no default interaction edge is invented.

reasons.curated_untraceable: A curated mechanism with no reference and no comment.
reasons.curated_no_target_assigned: A curated mechanism whose drug_mechanism.tid is NULL.
reasons.censored_only: Every measurement for the claim is a bound or approximation.
reasons.conditional_conversion_only: Every measurement for the claim depends on an unverified mass-basis conversion.
reasons.invalid_units_only: Every measurement carries units this policy will not normalise.
reasons.unresolved_study_provenance: Measurements exist but none resolves to an identifiable study.
reasons.documented_exclusion: Every backing record is on the documented known-bad exclusion list.

tiers.no_eligible_evidence: The parent is in the catalogue and chembl_37 holds no curated mechanism and no assessable activity for it at any claimable target. A coverage gap, retained and searchable.
tiers.not_assessed: A source this policy defers was not read. Unknown, never a negative finding.

provenance_class.publication: docs.doc_type = 'PUBLICATION' and a pubmed_id or doi is present.
provenance_class.patent: docs.doc_type = 'PATENT', or a patent_id with no publication identifier.
provenance_class.deposited_dataset: docs.doc_type = 'DATASET'. One bulk deposit regardless of row count.
provenance_class.unresolved: No doc row, or a doc with no pubmed_id, doi or patent_id.

study_identity.duplicate_resolution: Two doc rows collapse to one study when they share a pubmed_id or share a doi. Twenty measurement rows from one paper are one study.
study_identity.counts_are_separate: Measurements, studies and databases are three quantities, displayed separately and never added or compared without labels.
study_identity.changed_from_analysis: The report's study_key() labelled a pmid-bearing PATENT document as a deposited dataset. Production classifies doc_type first, so a patent stays a patent and cannot be mistaken for a deposit.

retained_as_bound.rule: Preserved with the relation exactly as reported. These are not exact values and are not interchangeable with each other. Excluded from exact medians, exact-value threshold passes and the multiple-study replication rule. A bounds-only claim never becomes a default Supported edge, and a bound is never labelled 'no activity'.
retained_as_bound.visible: Shown as labelled observations in evidence details, reachable from a catalogue entry without requiring a drawable edge.

measurement_validity.flags_do_not_exclude: An upstream validity or duplicate flag is recorded and shown, never used to drop a row automatically.

documented_exclusions.rule: Known-bad upstream records are excluded explicitly, with the reason preserved, on every ingestion path they can arrive by. Never a silent drop. Carried from CLAUDE.md invariant 9 and docs/DATA-QUALITY-LOG.md.

CHEMBL_MECHANISM_ACTION_EXCLUSIONS.record: ALFUZOSIN HYDROCHLORIDE (CHEMBL1723) at Adrenergic receptor alpha-1 (CHEMBL2094251)
CHEMBL_MECHANISM_ACTION_EXCLUSIONS.reason: ChEMBL files alfuzosin as an alpha-1 AGONIST, but the record's only reference, the DailyMed label it cites, says in section 12.1: "Alfuzosin is a selective antagonist of post-synaptic alpha1-adrenoreceptors." GtoPdb (antagonist at alpha-1A, 1B, 1D) and MeSH (Adrenergic alpha-1 Receptor Antagonists) agree with the label. Every other alpha-1 blocker in the same curation run (mec_id 1158-1170) is filed ANTAGONIST.

documented_exclusions.mechanism_action_rule: A curated mechanism whose action_type is contradicted by the reference it cites has that action withheld: the record stays, its claim keeps curated support, and ChEMBL's word is kept verbatim beside the reason. The action is never rewritten to the right one - that would be this project writing a ChEMBL record - so the direction comes from the other curator or from nowhere. Each entry names the action it expects, and the build fails if ChEMBL's record no longer says it, so a corrected or changed upstream record forces the entry to be reviewed rather than silently withholding a right answer. Added 2026-10-10 (docs/DATA-QUALITY-LOG.md).

organism_format_exclusion.rule: An activity row whose assay bao_format resolves to the label 'organism-based format' is excluded from active evidence, viewer context, graph, similarity and ranking, including the broader-assignment layer. The exclusion reason is retained and auditable.
organism_format_exclusion.changed_from_analysis: The report applied this gate only when assay_type = 'F'. chembl_37 also holds 1,632 organism-format assays typed 'B' carrying 34,791 activity rows, which that gate let through as binding evidence. D11 excludes organism-format observations from active evidence without qualification, so production applies it regardless of assay type.
organism_format_exclusion.not_imported: The follow-up's unsafe-pooling diagnostic is a measure of the risk, not an evidence route, and is not imported.

unit_conversion.scaled_syntax: Only an explicit 10^<integer> prefix followed by a supported concentration unit. Apostrophe exponent notation stays unresolved and is never guessed.
unit_conversion.verified_meaning: A dimensionally explicit concentration-to-concentration conversion. Enters tiers, medians and potency filters normally, with the original value, unit and conversion factor retained.

mass_conversion.weight_source: molecule_dictionary / compound_properties.full_mwt of the MEASURED ChEMBL record (activities.molregno), never the parent freebase weight.
identity_requirements: the measured record has a canonical structure
mass_conversion.conditional_meaning: D11: excluded from tiers, numeric potency summaries and threshold passes until the publication's measured material basis is verified. A source molecular weight alone does not establish whether the paper expressed mass as salt, freebase, hydrate or formulation. The computed value, weight, source form, original units, formula, assumptions and verification status are all stored and shown as conditional.
mass_conversion.unresolved_rule: Missing or ambiguous identity or weight produces an explicit unresolved result with its reason. Nothing is guessed, and small-molecule mass rules are never applied to mixtures, biologics or unresolved structures.
mass_conversion.verification_note: No literature-wide verification project is required for this release. A record can be promoted later by setting its verification state; nothing else about the record changes.

numeric_summaries.pooling: log10-space median within one (claim, endpoint_class), over qualifying exact values only.
numeric_summaries.reconciliation: Every displayed summary carries the count of measurement rows that produced it, and that count must equal the number of rows stored against it with counted = 1. Study support is a separate calculation and is never derived from the measurement count.
numeric_summaries.endpoint_visibility: When a role-level tier is derived from one qualifying endpoint class, that endpoint stays visible on the claim, so a tier earned at one endpoint cannot appear to certify another.

conflicts.action_conflict: Two or more curated mechanism records for the same (parent family, target) whose action_type maps to opposing parent_type (POSITIVE MODULATOR vs NEGATIVE MODULATOR). Both directions are preserved; neither is chosen by row order.
conflicts.measurement_dispersion: Within one (claim, endpoint_class) holding qualifying exact values from two or more distinct studies, log10(max/min) > 2.
conflicts.effect_on_tier: A conflict never raises a tier and never implies agreement. The claim keeps its tier and carries the conflict flag and detail.

similarity.counting_rule: A shared target counts once at its actual target identity, however many role or action rows the pair has at it. Multiple curated actions, or a binding plus a functional claim at one target, are one shared target.
similarity.identity_rule: Family and complex-group overlap is recorded and displayed distinguishably from exact single-protein overlap, and is never treated as equivalent to a subtype hit. One family claim is never expanded into overlaps at its members.

detailed_scoring.score: sum over shared targets of target_weight * min(evidence_weight_a, evidence_weight_b)
detailed_scoring.target_weight_reason: A precise complex is one receptor and is weighted like a single protein. A family or complex group is a claim about a set whose members may be different proteins, so a shared hit there is weaker evidence of acting alike than a shared single protein. Stated as a documented judgement, not a fact.
detailed_scoring.evidence_weight_reason: Both routes together is the strongest claim available here. Replication across publications is weighted slightly above a single curator's assertion; the gap is deliberately small because the two are different kinds of evidence rather than points on one scale.
detailed_scoring.min_rule_reason: A pair is only as well evidenced as its weaker side, so the minimum is taken rather than the sum or the mean.
detailed_scoring.potency_excluded: Potency never enters the score. It remains a display filter.
detailed_scoring.layer_rule: Optional layers are scored in their own basis and displayed separately. Enabling Preliminary or broader assignment can never raise the default direct-human score.

potency_filter.rule: D10: potency never decides catalogue membership, never decides evidence import, and never removes a catalogue member from search.
potency_filter.aggregation: A claim passes threshold T when the log10-space median of its qualifying exact nM values within an endpoint class is <= T * 1000 nM. The endpoint class the pass was computed in is labelled.
potency_filter.missing_value_treatment: A curated claim with no quantitative value, and a claim whose only values are bounds or conditional conversions, does not pass a numeric threshold and is never shown as passing one. The filter states how many claims it is hiding for want of a value rather than implying they failed it.
potency_filter.curated_preserved: Curated weak or unquantified mechanisms remain curated claims at every threshold.

legacy_reconciliation.legacy_rule: CLAUDE.md invariant 8: MAX_SUPPLEMENTARY_AFFINITY_NM = 300 uM gated supplementary auto-discovery at import time, so weaker evidence never reached the database.
legacy_reconciliation.resolution: Not used by this build. Import eligibility no longer depends on potency at all, so every eligible measurement is stored and the display filter operates over complete data. A value weaker than 300 uM is retained, counted and shown, and is hidden only while a display threshold is active.
legacy_reconciliation.reason: An import cutoff cannot be undone by a display control. D10 requires the filter to be reversible, so the cutoff had to move.

viewer_defaults.control_rule: Tier, assignment basis and potency are three separate controls. Each states what it is hiding. When a catalogue entry is hidden by one control and would be revealed by another, the viewer says which.

gap_reasons.label: No qualifying evidence found in ChEMBL 37
Source not assessed in this release

viewer_defaults.gap_rule: These are four different statements and are never collapsed into one. A source gap is never described as no known pharmacology, and no edge is ever manufactured to avoid an empty state.
